title: 第23章 师父竟然是太监第24章 谁念西风独自凉
slug: 我在修仙世界成了香饽饽
content_zh:
这一日的清晨，对于云阳宗的众人而言，宛如一场惊心动魄的噩梦拉开了帷幕，打破了往昔的平静与安宁。
接二连三的变故，让整个云阳宗沉浸在一片悲痛与迷茫之中。
仅仅一个早上，师父、大师兄、二师姐都相继离去。
他们的离去仿佛抽走了宗门的灵魂，让这曾经充满生机的地方变得死气沉沉。
下面的道童们个个面色苍白，眼神中充满了恐惧与不安。
他们在五师姐陆水瑶的命令下，先是小心翼翼地打扫着师父房间外围那一片狼藉的战场。
每一个动作都显得那么迟缓而沉重，仿佛被恐惧所束缚。
他们的双手颤抖着，清扫着地上的血迹与残骸。
那刺鼻的血腥味弥漫在空气中，让他们的心中更加惶恐。
打扫完毕后，道童们各自散去，去忙各自的事务，但他们的心中始终无法平静下来。
他们的眼神游离不定，不时地望向远方，仿佛在等待着什么，又仿佛在害怕着什么。
师父、大师兄、二师姐的离去，让他们失去了往日的依靠与指引。
他们的心中充满了迷茫与无助。
未来的日子里，等待他们的又将是怎样的命运？
············
从后山那片弥漫着悲伤与静谧的地方回到云阳宗。
一路上，杨欢敏锐地察觉到了道童们眼中深深的惊恐与不安。
但他只是默默地将这些情绪尽收眼底，并未过多言语，神色凝重地径直朝着师父云阳子的房间走去。
他的心中满是疑惑，师父云阳子今晨那诡异的“成仙”
之举，实在是太过蹊跷，让人费解。

他清楚地记得，大师兄与二师姐交谈时候说过，对云阳子下了七日散。
按照常理，云阳子应在七日后毒发身亡，可为何会出现如此反常的情况？
而且，昨天早上请安，他明明见到云阳子的身体状况不佳，怎么一夜之间就突然发生了如此天翻地覆的变化，还以那般诡异的模样“成仙”
这其中到底隐藏着怎样不为人知的秘密？
他觉得，自己无论如何都要将这件事弄个水落石出。
否则，这团迷雾将会一直笼罩在他的心头，让他寝食难安。
杨欢来到师父云阳子的房间门口，神色严肃地对一个道童吩咐道：“没有我的允许，谁都不许进来。”
那声音低沉而坚定，带着不容置疑的威严。
随后，他缓缓地推开房门，走了进去，又轻轻地将门关好，仿佛生怕惊扰了这房间里可能隐藏着的秘密。
此时的房间，已经被道童们仔细地打扫过了，整洁而干净。
除了墙壁上那被先前雷劈留下的触目惊心的黑色痕迹外，其他地方再无一丝血迹。
content_en:
The early morning of this day, for everyone in the Yunyang Sect, was like the beginning of a thrilling nightmare, breaking the peace and tranquility of the past.
The successive changes made the entire Yunyang Sect immersed in grief and confusion.
In just one morning, master, senior brother, and second senior sister all left one after another.
Their departure seemed to have taken away the soul of the sect, making this place that was once full of vitality become lifeless.
The Taoist boys below all looked pale, and their eyes were full of fear and uneasiness.
Under the orders of Fifth Senior Sister Lu Shuiyao, they first carefully cleaned the messy battlefield outside the master's room.
Every movement seemed so slow and heavy, as if bound by fear.
Their hands were trembling as they swept away the blood and debris on the ground.
The pungent smell of blood filled the air, making them even more frightened.
After the cleaning was completed, the Taoist boys dispersed and went about their own affairs, but their hearts could not calm down.
Their eyes were wandering, looking into the distance from time to time, as if they were waiting for something, and as if they were afraid of something.
The departure of their master, senior brother, and second senior sister caused them to lose their past reliance and guidance.
Their hearts are full of confusion and helplessness.
What fate awaits them in the days to come?
············
Returning to Yunyang Sect from the place in the back mountain that was filled with sadness and silence.
Along the way, Yang Huan was keenly aware of the deep fear and uneasiness in the Taoist boys' eyes.
But he just silently took in all these emotions without saying much, and walked straight towards his master Yunyangzi's room with a solemn expression.
His heart was full of doubts about Master Yunyangzi's strange "becoming an immortal" this morning.
This move is really too strange and puzzling.
He clearly remembered that the senior brother said during the conversation with the second senior sister that he had given Yunyangzi a seven-day ban.
According to common sense, Yunyangzi should have died of the poison seven days later, but why did such an abnormal situation occur?
Moreover, he said hello yesterday morning. He clearly saw that Yunyangzi's physical condition was not good, so why did she suddenly undergo such earth-shaking changes overnight, and "become an immortal" in such a strange appearance?
What kind of unknown secrets are hidden in this?
He felt that he must get to the bottom of this matter no matter what.
Otherwise, this fog will always hang in his mind, making it difficult for him to sleep or eat well.
Yang Huan came to the door of Master Yunyangzi's room and told a Taoist boy seriously: "No one is allowed to come in without my permission."
The voice was low and firm, with unquestionable majesty.
Then, he slowly opened the door, walked in, and closed the door gently, as if he was afraid of disturbing the secrets that might be hidden in the room.
At this time, the room had been carefully cleaned by the Taoist boys, making it neat and clean.
Except for the shocking black marks on the wall left by the previous lightning strike, there was no trace of blood anywhere else.
